title: George Smith deciphers the tablets, starting with Gilgamesh

tellings.quote: says here comes George Smith George Smith gets a hold of these he brings it back to the British museum he spends the next 10 years 10 years studying them

plain: A man named George Smith got hold of a set of ancient clay tablets, brought them back to the British Museum in London, and spent the next ten years studying them, starting with the Epic of Gilgamesh, an ancient poem from Mesopotamia. The researcher Matt LaCroix tells this in the 1870s setting without naming a source. He tells it because it is how these ancient texts first came to be read in the modern world.
